d:
Get ready to groove with the electrifying beats of "Sadda Dil Vi Tu (Ga Ga Ga Ganpati)" from the blockbuster movie Any Body Can Dance (ABCD). This high-energy song is a celebration of devotion and exuberance, dedicated to the mighty Lord Ganesha.
Don't miss out on this foot-tapping track that will leave you energized and uplifted! Hit play now and let the spirit of Ganpati take over!
Song Credits
Song: Sadda Dil Vi Tu (Ga Ga Ga Ganpati)
Singers: Hard Kaur
Composer: Sachin Jigar
Lyricist: Mayur Puri
Directed by: Remo D'Souza
